description: Start every test of a suite now, as one batch. Returns the batch_id and the run number of each started test. Use it to test the agent after a change, or before a release when the organization has no release gate. Follow the runs with list_runs and the batch_id. Uses conversation credits for every test in the suite.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

suite.description: The suite's id or name, as list_suites shows it. 'core' is the Core suite.
suite.title: Suite

name: run_suite
